paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-2 evaluation.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart titled "QA-2" represents the distribution of correctness in responses for two models: "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" and "RedWhale (our)". The categories are arranged vertically on the left with the respective model names, and the values are represented on a horizontal axis without a specified label. Each model is depicted by a horizontal stacked bar, divided into three segments representing "Correct", "Partially Correct", and "Incorrect". The "Correct" segment is colored in dark blue with values of 92.9 for EEVE-Korean and 95.7 for RedWhale. The "Partially Correct" segment is in a medium blue, showing values of 2.9 for EEVE-Korean and 1.4 for RedWhale. The "Incorrect" segment is light blue, with values of 4.3 for EEVE-Korean and 2.9 for RedWhale. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and there is no emphasis or distinct marking on any bar. The data for each section of the bars is explicitly labeled, providing a clear representation of the correctness distribution across the models. A legend is given in the bottom.
